text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Fluoxetine is a potent inhibitor of the CYP2D6 enzyme pathway [fluoxetine:drug_interactions:0], which is responsible for the metabolism of tramadol [tramadol:clinical_pharmacology:13]. Consequently, co-administration of fluoxetine with tramadol can lead to pharmacokinetic interactions and affect drug levels, requiring close monitoring for adverse reactions such as seizures and serotonin syndrome [tramadol:drug_interactions:2].
